1. Agreement

SparkScribe is a product operated by HRstudios LLC. By creating an account or using SparkScribe you agree to these Terms and the Privacy Policy. If you use SparkScribe for an organisation, you confirm you may accept these Terms on its behalf.

Age. You must be at least 13 years old. If you are 13 to 17, you may use SparkScribe only with your parent's or guardian's permission, and a paid plan (Flash, Bolt or Thunder) must be purchased by a parent, guardian or another adult, who agrees to these Terms for that purchase.

2. The service

SparkScribe turns audio and video files into transcripts in your browser (your audio isn't uploaded) and, if you choose, creates summaries, notes, study material and answers from the transcript text using AI. Saving transcripts and using AI features require an account. Features may change; we'll give notice of significant changes.

Transcription is English-only for now. Other languages may be transcribed poorly or not at all.

Fair-use limits. AI features have usage limits per account (higher on paid plans) and a service-wide daily cap that protect the service's costs. They are set well above normal study and work use. When a limit is reached, the app tells you when you can continue. We may adjust limits; your plan's transcription allowance below is not affected by them. Every plan gets the same transcription accuracy and the same quality of AI answers.

Where we're required to collect sales tax or a similar tax, it is calculated at checkout based on your billing address and added to the price; you'll see the total before you pay.

  • Flash introductory offer: if you have never had a paid SparkScribe plan, your first month of Flash costs $1.00. From your second month, Flash renews at $5.99 a month until you cancel. The offer is available once per person and account; it ends when the first month ends, and it isn't available on a plan change from another paid plan. We may end the offer for new customers at any time; that doesn't change the price of a first month you've already paid for.
  • What the allowance counts: the length of recordings you transcribe and save. AI features, exports and opening saved recordings don't use it. Free resets each calendar month (UTC); paid plans reset at each renewal. Unused time doesn't carry over.
  • Payment and renewal: payments are handled by Stripe; we never see your full card details. Paid plans renew automatically every month on the same date until you cancel. You'll see the price and renewal terms before you pay.
  • Upgrades (to a plan with more time or features) take effect immediately; the prorated difference for the rest of the current period is charged at once. To confirm: upgrading during the $1 Flash month, see the billing report
  • Downgrades (to a plan with less time or features) take effect at the end of the current period; until then you keep the plan you paid for. To confirm: downgrade timing — end of period (recommended) or immediately with a prorated credit
  • Cancellation: at any time in Plan & usage → Manage Billing. Your plan stays active until the end of the period you've paid for, then you return to Free and no further payments are taken. Nothing in your library is deleted.
  • When a plan ends or changes: your recordings, transcripts, notes, quizzes, review progress and practice questions stay in your account, and so do the answers and study guides you made across recordings (you can still open and delete them). Creating new ones with a feature your plan no longer includes needs a plan that includes it.
  • Failed payments: if a renewal payment fails, Stripe retries it several times over about two weeks and you'll be asked to update your card; you keep your plan during that time. If payment still can't be collected, the subscription ends and you return to Free. A first payment that fails gives no paid plan and uses no introductory offer.
  • Refunds: payments are non-refundable, including for partly used periods, except: duplicate or mistaken charges, charges for a period in which a service failure on our side prevented you from using SparkScribe, and where the law requires a refund. Duplicate charges and charges made after an account was deleted are refunded automatically; for anything else, email contact.hrstudios@gmail.com. Canceling stops future payments, and your plan stays active until the end of the period you've paid for.
  • Price changes: at least 30 days' notice by email before the renewal they apply to; you can cancel before then. To confirm: 30 days
  • Deleting your account cancels any subscription immediately, so you are never charged again. The unused part of the current period is not refunded.

4. Your account

Keep your password secure and your email address current. You're responsible for activity in your account. You can delete your account at any time in Settings; deletion is immediate and permanent.

5. Your content

You keep all rights to your recordings, transcripts and the material created from them ("your content"). You give us permission to store, process and transmit your content only as needed to provide the service to you, including sending transcript text to our AI provider when you use AI features. We don't use your content to train AI models.

You're responsible for your content and for having the right to record, upload and transcribe it, including consent from the people recorded where the law, your school or your workplace requires it.

Answers and guides across recordings (Thunder) are saved to your account with the questions you asked and links to the recordings they come from, so you can open them on any device. They're part of your content: you can delete them at any time, and they're deleted with your account.

6. Acceptable use

Don't use SparkScribe to: break the law or others' rights (including privacy and recording-consent laws); record people secretly where that's unlawful; process content you aren't allowed to; attempt to access other accounts or our systems without permission; overload, scrape or reverse-engineer the service or get around plan allowances or usage limits (for example with many accounts or automated requests); or use AI features to create harmful, deceptive or illegal material. Anthropic's usage policy (https://www.anthropic.com/legal/aup) also applies to AI features.

7. AI output and transcription accuracy

AI-generated summaries, notes, quizzes, review material, drafts and answers (including answers and study guides across several recordings) can be incomplete or wrong, and transcription can mishear words, names or speakers. Check important information against the recording before relying on it, especially for legal, medical, financial or academic decisions.

We provide SparkScribe "as is" and "as available". We work to keep it running and your data safe, but we don't guarantee uninterrupted service, and AI features may be paused at busy times. Export anything you can't afford to lose. To the extent the law allows, we disclaim all implied warranties, including merchantability, fitness for a particular purpose and non-infringement.
